subject: numbers received by shiny output js come across with different values

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: numbers received by shiny output js come across with different values
parts:
Hi,

I have created a shiny output widget. My R code is sending some objects across which include numerical values. I've turned on 
options(shiny.trace=TRUE)
so I can see what is supposedly being sent to my browser.

Here's an excerpt:
 "group": "nodes",
"data": {
 "id": "YKR026C" 
},
"position": {
 "x": 3297,
"y": 123 
} 

Then in my browser, I inspect what is received by the output binding's renderValue() function, and the matching object comes across with the same 'data' and 'group', but the 'position' is 
changed to {x: 547.2727272727273, y: 360.56666666666666}.

This is before my code touches the data that comes over, so it's not doing any scaling or anything like that. All of the numbers on the R side are integers and they all come across as decimal numbers.

What's going on?

The app is here:
https://s3.amazonaws.com/yeastCyDemo/yeastCyDemo.tar.gz

Thanks,
Dan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: numbers received by shiny output js come across with different values
parts:
Looks like the position is being changed by cytoscape (scaling to the canvas size or whatever, I imagine). Turns out console.log calls are asynchronous, and although you're logging before the data is changed, the objects are passed by reference so by the time they're actually written, the values are different.
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/8747421/javascript-console-prints-assigned-value-of-variable-before-it-has-been-assigned

You can confirm this by replacing console.log(data) with console.log(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data))), which will copy the data.
